subset_selection: evenly spaced packed test indices, endpoint inclusive; no outcome-based selection
spatial_definition: explicit analyst partition of PSG predicates: static placement/containment/attachment. Action predicates such as sitting on, standing on, riding remain semantic; not official alpha routing ground truth.

neg_types: role reversal, contextual rather than logical antonym

e01_selection: first four distinct test images per target predicate, lexicographically first GT pair; no dependence on predictions; manual contextual caveats required

decision_rules.E01: compare exact fixed-pair raw predicate and fused scores, ranks, max-positive minus max-negative margin, positive paraphrase spread; report all 24 selected cases and wording caveats; not proof of unseen semantics
decision_rules.E02: report all seeds/levels with R,mR,F1, per-type GT pooled hits, selected-pair coverage and selected-pair predicate accuracy; distinguish pruning and classification; fixed identities, not SGDet
decision_rules.E03: compare weight 0 vs 1 on identical full-test logits and pair sets, no recalibration or threshold tuning
decision_rules.E04: compare original against each image intervention on same 300 indices/boxes/vocabulary; OOD intervention cannot by itself identify causal visual reasoning
decision_rules.V01: record actual per-head query-to-patch weights; report recomputation precision discrepancy; attention is descriptive, not causal attribution
